useCases.title: How we'd approach situations like these
useCases.note: The examples below are illustrations of approach. They are not delivered projects or verified results.

items.problem: If you collect results from several ad platforms by hand every time
items.approach: We bring campaign data into one place and design a flow where AI drafts the reports and insights automatically.

items.problem: If customers keep asking the same questions and your team is short on time
items.approach: We look at an AI support assistant that searches your FAQ and internal documents to cut response time.

items.problem: If you check transactions and wallets across several networks one by one
items.approach: We design a way to collect transactions by chain and bring them into a single monitoring dashboard.

process.title: Start small, leave something solid
process.lead: We'd rather show you a four-week result than a grand proposal. Validate with a pilot, then scale.

steps.name: Diagnose
steps.text: We review your data and systems and find where AI or blockchain can actually deliver results.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: We agree on target metrics first, then design the architecture and prototype.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: We build and demo in two-to-four-week cycles and improve fast on your team's feedback.

steps.name: Operate
steps.text: We stay accountable for monitoring, access control, and model and contract updates.

why.title: We don't sell technology. We build results with you.
why.lead: Adopting new technology always feels risky. That's why we don't slice up scope and responsibility.

items.name: One team, end to end
items.text: Planning, development, marketing and operations aren't split. One team owns the target metric.

items.name: Proven by metrics
items.text: We decide with data, not hunches. Every improvement comes with a measurable metric.

items.name: Security by default
items.text: Access separation, audit logs and contract review are designed in from day one.

why.honesty: If the free diagnosis concludes that you don't need this yet, we'll tell you. Blockchain often isn't the answer.

faq.q: Do we need a lot of data to adopt AI?
faq.a: No. You can start with the inquiry logs, ad data and internal documents you already have. If data is thin, we design how to collect it first.

faq.q: How do we know if our business really needs blockchain?
faq.a: It pays off where trust is expensive: tamper-proof records, asset ownership, settlement between several parties. If you don't need it, the free diagnosis will say so plainly.

faq.q: Can you connect to our existing store or CRM?
faq.a: Yes. We work with REST and webhook integrations and major commerce and CRM APIs. We prefer connecting only what's needed rather than replacing your systems.

faq.q: How are timeline and cost decided?
faq.a: It depends on scope, but a pilot usually takes about four weeks. After the diagnosis we document the scope and quote, and work to that.

faq.q: Do you market crypto and Web3 projects?
faq.a: Yes. We cover community operations around exchange listings, global channel advertising and on-chain data targeting. We never run promotion that promises prices or returns.
